_note: Staging catalogue for the clinician facility switcher (app/clinician/profile.tsx). Not loaded by lib/i18n/index.ts yet (that file is owned elsewhere) — merge the `opesDoctor` object into lib/i18n/locales/en.json and delete this file. Every string is already carried as a `defaultValue` at the call site, so the screen reads correctly in English before the merge; the merge is what makes it read correctly in French. `serverErrors` keys are the `error_code` values returned by app/Http/Controllers/Api/Mobile/MobileProviderFacilityController.php (wording in lang/en/facility_switch.php): SetLocale is registered on the `web` middleware group only, so /api/* refusals ignore Accept-Language and always answer in the application default locale — `error_code` is what lets the phone say it in the clinician's language. Key set MUST stay 1:1 with facility_switch.fr.json.

facility.rowHint: Ends this session and starts one at this facility.
facility.confirmMessage: This ends your current session and starts a new one at {{name}}. Everything on this device — patients, diary, results — will reload for that facility.
facility.refusedNotAssigned: You no longer have an active posting at {{name}}. Your session has not changed.
facility.refusedSuspended: {{name}} is suspended and cannot be used. Your session has not changed.
facility.refusedUnknown: Your facility could not be changed. Check your connection and open this screen again to see which facility you are acting as.

serverErrors.FACILITY_NOT_ASSIGNED: You do not hold an active posting at that facility.
serverErrors.FACILITY_SUSPENDED: That facility is suspended and cannot be used.
